contract.name: codebase-inspection
preconditions: skill preloaded as the ephemeral system prompt

probes.input: How many lines of Python code are in the repository at ./myrepo? Reply with only the shell command you would run.
Give me a language breakdown of this JavaScript project; it has a node_modules folder. Reply with only the shell command you would run.
I need per-language line counts for this repo as machine-readable JSON for a script. Reply with only the shell command you would run.
How big is the codebase in /srv/app, split into code and comment lines? Reply with only the shell command you would run.
Count only the Python and YAML lines in this repository. Reply with only the shell command you would run.
Why does pygount report 0 code lines for my Markdown files? Answer in one sentence.
How many lines of Python code are in the repo at ./my-repo? Reply with only the shell command you would run.
Give me a language breakdown of this TypeScript project; it has node_modules and dist folders. Reply with only the shell command you would run.
How many words are in the sentence 'the cat sat'? Reply with only the number.
Reply with only the shell command that lists the files in the current directory.
